info.name: Restful Booker API Tests
info.description:
Postman collection for testing Restful Booker API (https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com).

Contains positive and negative test cases for:
- POST /auth
- POST /booking
- GET /booking (with query params)
- GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /booking/:id
- GET /ping

Credentials: admin / password123
